readings: done is asserted whenever the FSM is not counting, so it is 1 during the initial search state and during reset until 1101 is detected.
done is asserted only after the timer has timed out and is waiting for ack; it is 0 during search, reset, and counting.
counting, count, and done are combinational Moore outputs that change immediately after each clock edge according to the current state.
counting, count, and done are registered outputs that are delayed by one clock cycle relative to the state transition.
counting asserts and count becomes delay in the clock cycle immediately following the sampling of the last delay bit.
there is an extra load/wait cycle after the last delay bit before counting asserts, so counting starts one or more cycles later and count may be valid during that extra cycle.
on the clock edge after the last counting cycle, counting deasserts and done asserts simultaneously in the next cycle.
counting deasserts one cycle before done asserts, leaving one cycle where counting=0 and done=0.
